references.text: The same principle that all Israel should hear and fear, so that evil is not done again among the people
Identical wording stating that the people should hear and fear, and no longer act wickedly
The same deterrent purpose: all Israel should hear and fear through the punishment of a disobedient son
Public punishment so that others may see and fear, as a warning example
The punishment of Achan was to serve as a warning for all Israel, so that they would not do evil again
Paul instructs on public rebuke of sinners, so that the rest may fear
